Effect your next shot this turn gains a flat +1 circumstance bonus to hit, regardless of time-in-sights

Spend a full action doing nothing but breathing and aiming.

cinderfall.incomplete: flat +1 to next shot for spending a full action aiming. (this one, like crossed-aim, is a plausible REAL candidate if it were reframed as a standing toggle rather than a one-shot action — flagged in Open Questions). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
